definitions.gloss: first death anniversary; first yearly memorial
definitions.explanation: A Buddhist memorial service held one year after a person's death. An important milestone in the traditional mourning cycle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一周忌|いっしゅうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: It's been one year since my father's passing.

examples.japanese: {一周忌|いっしゅうき}⟦{法要|ほうよう}→法要：05924_houyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{寺|てら}→お寺：23515_otera⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: We gathered at the temple for the first anniversary memorial service.

examples.japanese: {一周忌|いっしゅうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{期|き}→期：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{喪服|もふく}→喪服：11898_mofuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}なくなる→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: After the first anniversary, mourning clothes are no longer worn.

notes:
{一周忌|いっしゅうき} marks one full year since death and is the first of the annual memorials.

MEMORIAL ANNIVERSARY SEQUENCE:
- {一周忌|いっしゅうき}: 1 year (first death anniversary)
- ⟦{三回忌|さんかいき}→三回忌：06019_sankaiki⟧: 2 years ("third" by traditional counting)
- ⟦{七回忌|ななかいき}→七回忌：28963_nanakaiki⟧: 6 years
- ⟦{十三回忌|じゅうさんかいき}→十三回忌：28964_juusankaiki⟧: 12 years
- ⟦{三十三回忌|さんじゅうさんかいき}→三十三回忌：29130_sanjuusankaiki⟧: 32 years (often the final formal service)

NOTE: The counting includes the year of death, so ⟦{三回忌|さんかいき}→三回忌：06019_sankaiki⟧ is held 2 years after death.
